title: api-client.ts request() sent Content-Type: application/json on a BODYLESS call (autoSchedule's POST, every DELETE) -> Fastify 400s with 'Body cannot be empty when content-type is set to application/json'
detail: Fix: only set Content-Type when init.body !== undefined and is not FormData (`const hasBody = init?.body !== undefined`). Symptom: clicking Auto-schedule in the browser threw that exact string as a banner.

title: api-client.ts request() always parsed the response as JSON, including on 204 No Content (every removeX DELETE) -> the failed parse was read as body?.success being falsy and thrown as ApiError even though res.ok was true
detail: Fix: short-circuit on `res.status === 204` before attempting res.json(), returning undefined without parsing. Symptom: clicking Remove on a staff/shift/roster-assignment row banner-errored 'Request failed with status 204' despite the DELETE having actually succeeded server-side.
